description:
FILED s507 (Fable, 2026-10-04) from review probes written for s502e (#2537: `use constant E => ()` in a list).  PRE-EXISTING: main 2e71d4aa and the s502e tree answer alike.  NOT caused by any batch in flight.

WHY IT MATTERS: the no-op hook / default-method idiom -- `sub extra_args { }` overridden in a subclass, called as `my %args = (a => 1, $self->extra_args)` or `push @all, $self->hook` -- pushes an undef where perl pushes nothing: an odd-length hash list, a `@errors` array that is true, an argument list one longer.  Silent.

PROBE (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s507/review/e9-empty2.pl, outputs out/e9.perl / out/e9.base; `sub e3 { } sub e0 { () } sub cnt { scalar(@_) } sub one { 1 }`):
  row  shape                                          perl   main
  01   my @a = e3(); scalar(@a)                        0      0     (right)
  02   my @b = (e3());                                 0      1
  03   my @c = (e3(), 1);                              1      2
  04   push @d, e3();                                  0      1
  05   scalar(@{[ e3() ]})                             0      0     (right)
  06   cnt(e3()), cnt(e3(), 1), cnt(e0())              0 1 0  1 2 1
  07   $n++ for e3();                                  0      1
  09   join(",", e3(), 1)                              "1"    ",1"
  11   (one(), e3(), one())                            2      3
  12   ($o->hook, $o->lst, 1)  (K::hook { } K::lst { () })  1  3
  14   push @d, $o->hook                               +0     +1
  15   my $cr = \&e3; ($cr->(), 1)                     1      2
  16   (&e3, 1)   17  (e3, 1)                          1      2
  22   (do { }, 1)                                     1      2
  24   (sub { }->(), 1)                                1      2
  RIGHT on main: `sub e9 { return; }` (18), `sub { my @l = (); @l }` (21), a literal `((), 1)` (23), `map { e0() } 1..3` (0 elements), `e0() ? :` and `() = e0()`.
  Also e8-empty.pl: `sub e5 { my $x = shift; (); }` and `sub e6 { if ($_[0]) { () } else { (1, 2) } }` -> 2 elements where perl has 1.

CHEAP DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (not taken): `./pl2cl` on `sub e3 { } my @c = (e3(), 1);` and on `sub e9 { return; } my @c = (e9(), 1);` -- compare the two sub bodies and the two call sites.  Seen in passing (s502e's c1.pl): `use constant E => ()` emits the body `(progn %_args (progn))`, whose value is NIL, and the list site wraps it as `(vector (p-list-ctx (pl-E)) 1)` -- so NIL becomes an element.  An ordinary `return;` evidently yields the EMPTY VECTOR in list context.  Two candidate fix sites, to be decided by that measurement: (a) the sub-body lowering -- a body whose value is the empty form returns `(if *wantarray* (vector) nil)` exactly as `return;` does (rule 11: the sibling is the bare `return`); (b) the list flattener treating a NIL from a list-context call as zero elements (riskier: NIL vs undef is load-bearing, ir-spec data model).  (a) is the expected one.

BREAKING CASES to probe before shipping: scalar context stays undef (`my $s = e3()` -- every row above has it right today); `sub f { }` as a sort/map/grep block callee; an empty sub used as a DESTROY/import/BUILD (value ignored); `sub f { 1 if $x }`-style bodies whose LAST statement is a false statement-modifier (perl returns the condition's value -- rows 19/20 above are right today and must stay); signature subs with an empty body (#752, pending, same family: fold it in).

Related: #752 (empty-bodied SIGNATURE sub returns its parameter unpack's value), #962 / #459 (failed match in a list: the same "false element instead of the empty list" class, fixed), #2537 (list constants; `use constant E => ()` is this bug at the constant's sub).


=== DONE (s507b, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-04) ===
The measurement: `sub e3 { }` emitted `(p-args-body (block nil))`, `sub e0 { () }` `(block nil (progn))` -- both NIL --
while a bare `return;` emits `(p-return-empty)`.  Fix in the SUB-BODY lowering (rule 11, the bare return's value
without the throw): an empty body (Parser2::_lower_body_regime; the anon-sub empty arm; v1's text path for the
signature subs it still owns), a tail statement `()` (Parser2 expression-statement arm, `_is_empty_list_expr`), an
empty taken if/unless branch or tail bare block (`_lower_scope`'s entry), an empty `do { }` / `eval { }`
(`_lower_embedded_body`), and `use constant E => ()` (v1 `_emit_constant`) all end in `(p-return-empty)`.
Manifest: p-return-empty no longer claims :nonlocal_exit.return (it throws nothing).  Generation v2-4080.
Probes (scratch/s507b/p/): e9-empty2.pl and e8-empty.pl identical to perl; m1b.pl / m1d.pl identical except two
PRE-EXISTING shapes filed as #2700 (a body that is ONLY `my ($x) = @_`) and #2701 (`{;` read as an anon hash).
Breaking cases kept: rows 19/20 (false bare-if / loop as last statement), scalar context undef, `{ }` (anon hash),
map/grep/sort callees, DESTROY/import/BUILD, anon and method calls.  e1-const rows 04 and 44 now identical.
Guard Pl/t/transpile-test-10.t rows 88 (#2680) and 89 (#752), both FAIL on 08de9e4f.
corpus-diff vs 08de9e4f: 23 of 111 files differ, every hunk one of: 26 empty named bodies, 10 v1 signature empty
bodies, 10 empty anon subs, 10 tail `()` / empty taken branch + 8 bare-if ret-var branches, 3 empty do/eval, 2
`:needs` drops; silent drops 5, unchanged.  Population (regex count): perl-tests 50 named + 15 anon empty subs in
25 files, lib/ 5 in 3 files, everyday 1.  Bench `emptysub` (scalar + list call of an empty sub): tree 0.366 s;
the base answers WRONG there (BROKEN), so no A/B; subret / fibret / methret within noise (bench-*.log).
subject: SILENT WRONG (found by a s507 review probe, PRE-EXISTING on main 2e71d4aa): an EMPTY-valued sub -- `sub f { }`, a body whose last statement is a bare `()`, a `do { }` -- contributes ONE undef ELEMENT to an enclosing list (`(f(), 1)`, `push @a, f()`, `g(f())`, `[f()]`-style lists, a method call `$o->hook`); perl contributes NONE.  Only `my @a = f()` is right.
